name: Power Up Renewable Energy
old_description: Serving the Ohio, USA area. Power Up Renewable Energy specializes in solar panel maintenance and solar panel repair. NABCEP Certified. 25 Year warranty. Free estimates within 24 hours. Call today for a free estimate.
about:
Power Up Renewable Energy was founded in 2010 in Worthington, Ohio, as a locally owned solar energy company serving customers throughout the state. The business began with a focus on providing solar panel maintenance and repair, later expanding into full-system sales, battery backup, and generator installation.

The company provides solar sales, repair, and maintenance services, along with whole-home generator installation and battery backup systems. Its technicians handle everything from routine panel cleaning and performance diagnostics to complete system replacements and energy storage integration. All work is performed by in-house employees rather than subcontractors.

Power Up serves residential and commercial customers across Ohio, including homeowners seeking to reduce utility bills and businesses pursuing energy efficiency audits and commercial solar solutions. The company also works with clients needing backup power for critical loads during grid outages.

The firm emphasizes its NABCEP certification, a 25-year warranty on solar products, free estimates delivered within 24 hours, and complimentary site visits. Ownership cites its local roots and direct-employment model as key to maintaining quality and accountability on every project.
